ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a topographic map of the United Kingdom. It can be seen that the United Kingdom is surrounded by oceans and is an island country; the land area is not large, the whole is relatively long and narrow, the coastline is relatively winding, and many areas are close to the coast. Then reason: Rivers generally flow from higher terrain toward the ocean. If the land area is small and close to the sea, the course of a river from source to mouth is usually relatively short. Therefore, the characteristic of most rivers in the United Kingdom in terms of length is short.
